name: download_python
description: Downloads an embedded/redistributable CPython for the current OS (python.org embeddable on Windows, python-build-standalone on macOS/Linux)
author: Orcha Team

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: CPython version to download (e.g. 3.13.13). Defaults to a recent stable release.

parameters.name: release_tag
parameters.description: python-build-standalone release tag (YYYYMMDD) used for macOS/Linux. Defaults to the release that bundles the default version. Ignored on Windows.
